text: こんな　まけかた　したら…　…　リーダーに　おこられる！

structure.jp: こんな　まけかた　したら…
structure.en: if I lose in a way like this...

structure.jp: リーダーに　おこられる！
structure.en: I'll get yelled at by the Leader!

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: リーダーに　おこられる
patterns.explanation: The られる ending says the action is done to the speaker, and に shows who does it. リーダーに　おこられる = 'I'll get yelled at by the Leader'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that happens. まけかた　したら = 'if I lose like this'.

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた stuck onto the stem of a verb means 'the way of doing' it. まけかた = 'a way of losing'.
